name: lamina-rubra-tools
description: Gera a versão autocontida do jogo 3D e os pacotes para Windows (.exe) e Android (.apk).

scripts.desktop: node standalone.mjs desktop && node icon/make.mjs && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.android: node standalone.mjs android && cd android && npm install && (test -d android || npm run prepare-android) && npx cap sync android && node ../icon/make.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
